snippet.title: Portal Master Of Games
snippet.description:
Welcome to Portal Master Of Games — PMOG. 🐺  
I’m a wolf VTuber creating livestreams, gaming videos, Shorts, animations, art, memes, and whatever strange project catches my attention next.
Gaming is a big part of this channel, but no single game owns the place. If you have a game, challenge, or idea you think I should try, feel free to recommend it. Everyone is welcome here.
I also make animations and personal projects whenever inspiration decides to bite.
Expect games, chaos, experiments, questionable decisions, creative projects, and a wolf who somehow keeps finding new things to work on.
This old wolf hasn’t lost his fangs yet.

I come to greet.
I come to watch.
I come to say goodbye.
I savor the memories we make as time slowly burns them away.
I color this world in my own hues and pull its strings where I can.
All in the name of me, myself, and I.

Love you all.
May fate bring us together again. ;)

Subscribe and join the pack:
https://www.youtube.com/@PMOG

Today… something is moving beneath Old Town, and I can feel it long before anyone else touches a single block.

While PJ, Mr. Lgoo, and Nickster search for whatever the Core dragged into this world, I’m following my own signals — faint echoes coming from the Temple of Salt. The cult there performs their daily rituals like nothing is wrong… but the air feels different. Heavier. Like the Watcher is already aware of what’s coming.

And when I step inside, it’s waiting for me.

A presence.
A warning.
A reminder that my training is far from over.

I bring offerings of salt — not for the temple, but for what’s about to be unvaulted in Old Town. The world is shifting again, and I’m the only one who can hear the cracks forming.

They think they’re uncovering history.
But I think something ancient is waking up.

And this time, the Core isn’t the only thing watching.
